account:
Today seems quiet rather than troubled. The treasury held 128 emeralds when I checked, and the secretary reported no outstanding bills or confirmed delivery assignments. Freight has been asking about deliveries and offering ferry crossings; I have no evidence of anything beyond seeking work. At tea, my neighbour reported no problems around the dock cottages.

The main complication has been communication during the builder's appointment. He reported no confirmed defects at the bridge, landing, or warehouse, so I initially declined unnecessary work. He then proposed a preventive inspection of town hall doors, bridge decking, and the landing for two emeralds, with repairs quoted separately. I approved that limited inspection, payable upon written findings at tomorrow's 16:30 appointment, but he apparently left without hearing the approval. The secretary first repeated my earlier refusal, then acknowledged the updated authorization. She will relay the exact terms and obtain his acceptance, which remains pending. No repairs or extra charges are authorized.

This looks like ordinary maintenance planning and a timing misunderstanding, not evidence of misconduct or an emergency. Two written books are now in the appointments chest; I have seen the contents listing but have not yet read the additional office notes. I should review them, keep tomorrow's mill inspection and office appointments, and be home for 19:00.
